summary: Verified Salt Spray Kartu Pengamatan — Header DATA PENGUJIAN + TABEL REPORT + numeric Jam Pengamatan. 6/6 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend UI: header saves & persists after reload; report table renders rows per unique sample code; 100% cells are red; auto-fill of later-hour cells works; dynamic column extension to 216/240 when card at 240h exists; KARTU BARU draft hours pre-filled to nextReportHour (264 after 240); EXPORT PDF builds iframe with all 3 sections and no page errors. Test cards & header restored.
critical_code_review_comments: obsReport.js buildReport: later card at same hour overwrites earlier (data[alias][h] = pctOf(p)). Current list sort is by hours then seq ascending — so highest-seq same-hour card wins; acceptable but worth documenting.

/salt-spray/observations save button is disabled while plates.length !== 4, so the hours-required toast error ('Isi Jam Pengamatan…') is only reachable in the edit path, not the draft path. Not a bug; just a UX note.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST cards via API (hours 6, 24, 240) using plates copied from an existing new-format card; deleted all at end. Header set to TEST_UI_Operator / 15 psi during test, then restored to original.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_salt_obs_header.py is independent of AI vision (clones template plates). Safe to re-run. The original 3 user cards (hours 0, 1, 24) were preserved. If running UI tests, remember Observations page uses REPORT_HOURS = [0,1,2,3,4,5,6,24,...192] and dynamically appends +24 columns until the maxObserved hour.
